lead: Find out in two minutes which social benefits you may be entitled to, and prepare the application right away.
sample: These are example values. Replace them with your own details. Everything stays on your device, nothing is saved or sent.
trans: The names of benefits and offices stay in German so you can use them when you talk to the authorities. The translations are machine-made and may contain errors.

kids.label: Children under 18

cb.alter: An adult has reached the standard retirement age (65 to 67, depending on year of birth)
cb.erwerb: An adult is permanently and fully unable to work (volle Erwerbsminderung)
cb.behind: A person in the household has a degree of disability of 100
cb.kinder12: A child is 12 years or older
cb.unterhalt: The other parent pays no child support or too little

ausb.label: School, training or university

rules.sum: How the check works and where the values come from
rules.intro: The check compares your details with the limits set by law. It is a guide only and does not replace an official decision.
rules.de: The details are in German, as in the laws.
rules.src: The values come from statutes and advice portals and should be professionally reviewed before wide use.
foot.1: Important: This check gives a first estimate. It is not legal advice and not an official decision. The responsible office decides on your claim.
foot.2: Free help with filling in forms is available from welfare associations such as VdK and SoVD and from advice centres of Caritas, Diakonie and AWO.
f.intro: Enter your details. You get an informal application letter, a data sheet and a document list to print. Your data stays on your device.
f.name: First and last name
f.none: No benefit to prepare right now.
f.pick0: Please choose at least one benefit.
f.copyFail: Copying did not work. Select the text below and copy it by hand.
f.deNote: The letter and the data sheet are in German because the offices need them that way. You can hand them in or send them as they are.
f.stichtag: For many benefits an informal application secures the starting month. You send the official form afterwards.
h.ausschluss: Excluded by a benefit you receive
h.schonGrund: You already receive a basic security benefit
h.butMoeglich: Possible if another benefit is approved
n.but: Education and participation package for children
n.gsa: Basic security in old age or with reduced earning capacity
zu.uvg: Unterhaltsvorschussstelle (in the Jugendamt, youth welfare office)
t.kindergeld.ja: You get {kg} per month for each child until the child is 18, or up to 25 if in training or studies.
t.kindergeld.na: Report changes such as the end of training or a move to the Familienkasse.
t.kindergeld.keinKind: Child benefit is paid for children up to 18, and up to 25 if in training.
t.wohngeld.ausschluss: People who receive Grundsicherungsgeld or basic security from the authorities do not get Wohngeld. The rent is already covered there.
t.wohngeld.na: Apply for the extension in good time. Report changes in income, rent or household.
t.wohngeld.verm: With substantial assets there is no Wohngeld. Guide value for household size {n}: about {limit}. The Wohngeldstelle decides each case individually.
t.wohngeld.hoch: Your gross income is above the Wohngeld limit.
t.wohngeld.grenzeStufe: Limit (household size {n}, rent level {stufe}): about {lo} to {hi} gross per month, depending on deductions.
t.wohngeld.grenzeOhne: Limit (household size {n}): about {lo} to {hi} gross per month, depending on rent level and deductions.
t.wohngeld.ja: Your income is below the Wohngeld limit.
t.wohngeld.vielleicht: You are in the borderline range. The Wohngeldstelle calculates deductions and allowances exactly.
t.wohngeld.stufeUnbekannt: Your rent level is unknown, so the check calculates cautiously.
t.wohngeld.zuNiedrig: Wohngeld requires a minimum income. Your income probably does not cover living costs and rent. In that case basic security is often the right benefit. You can still apply for Wohngeld.
t.kiz.keinKind: The Kinderzuschlag is only paid for children who get Kindergeld (under 25 years).
t.kiz.ausschluss: Kinderzuschlag and basic security exclude each other. The children are already covered there.
t.kiz.na: Apply for the extension in good time. It is usually granted for six months.
t.kiz.minEink: For the Kinderzuschlag you need at least {min} gross per month. With less, Grundsicherungsgeld is more likely.
t.kiz.zuHoch: Your income is so high that probably nothing is left of the Kinderzuschlag.
t.kiz.zuNiedrig: The Kinderzuschlag is meant to prevent the need for basic security. If income is too low for that, Grundsicherungsgeld fits better. You can still apply.
t.kiz.ja: Your income is in the right range. Maximum: {max} per child and month.
t.kiz.rand: You are near the upper limit, a small amount may remain. Maximum: {max} per child and month.
t.ggeld.sozialamtZustaendig: From the standard retirement age, or with permanent full incapacity to work, the Sozialamt is responsible, not the Jobcenter. See Grundsicherung im Alter.
t.ggeld.na: Report changes to the Jobcenter and apply for the extension in good time.
t.ggeld.sozialamt: You already receive basic security or social assistance from the Sozialamt. You cannot get both.
t.ggeld.verm: Financial assets above about {schon} have to be used first. The protected amount depends on age.
t.bedarfJa: Your needs (standard rate plus rent) are about {bedarf} per month. Your income is below that.
t.bedarfRand: Your needs (standard rate plus rent) are about {bedarf} per month. Your income is just below or just above that. The office calculates allowances and deductions exactly.
t.bedarfNein: Your needs (standard rate plus rent) are about {bedarf} per month. Your income is above that. Check whether Wohngeld fits.
t.but.keinKind: The education package applies to children and young adults up to 25 in school or training.
t.but.inhalt: It includes {schul} school supplies per year, {teil} per month for sport, music or culture, lunch at daycare and school, and school trips.
t.but.bezug: You already receive a suitable benefit, so you are entitled to it.
t.but.folgt: Anyone who receives Wohngeld, Kinderzuschlag or basic security is also entitled to the education package.
t.but.moeglich: The claim depends on receiving Wohngeld, Kinderzuschlag or basic security.
t.but.fehlt: The education package goes to families receiving basic security, Wohngeld, Kinderzuschlag or social assistance. According to your details this probably does not apply.
t.uvg.keinKind: Unterhaltsvorschuss is paid for children under 18.
t.uvg.unterhalt: Unterhaltsvorschuss is paid when the other parent pays no child support or too little. You did not state this.
t.uvg.zwei: Unterhaltsvorschuss is for single parents. It ends if you marry or live with the other parent. With a new unmarried partner it can continue.
t.uvg.ab12: From age 12 it is only paid if the child does not depend on Grundsicherungsgeld or you earn at least {min} gross.
t.uvg.ja: Amount per month: up to 5 years {a}, 6 to 11 years {b}, 12 to 17 years {c}. Child support actually paid is deducted. At most until the 18th birthday.
t.gsa.voraus: Basic security in old age is paid from the standard retirement age or with permanent full incapacity to work. You stated neither.
t.gsa.na: Report changes in pension, rent or assets to the Sozialamt and apply for the extension in good time.
t.gsa.ggBezug: You receive Grundsicherungsgeld from the Jobcenter. At the retirement age, or with permanent incapacity to work, the Sozialamt takes over.
t.gsa.verm: Financial assets above {schon} have to be used first. A home you live in yourself or a reasonable car do not count.
t.bafoeg.keine: You did not state anyone in school, training or university.
t.bafoeg.keinKind: You did not state a child in the household.
t.bafoeg.kindJa: The parents' income is below the allowance of about {fb} net per month. BAföG is paid for university, vocational colleges and certain schools, for example if the child does not live with the parents.
t.bafoeg.kindRand: The income is above the allowance of about {fb} per month. BAföG is then reduced but can still be paid. The office calculates exactly.
t.bafoeg.kindNein: The income is well above the allowance of about {fb} per month. Probably nothing is left.
t.bafoeg.ich: BAföG depends mainly on the parents' income, which this check does not ask for. In some cases it does not count. Have the Amt für Ausbildungsförderung calculate it.
t.bafoeg.vermHoch: Your assets are above the limit of {verm}.
t.bafoeg.alter: As a rule BAföG is only paid if you are at most 45 when the training starts, for some courses younger. Ask the office.
t.pflege.keiner: You did not state a care level. Anyone who needs lasting help in daily life can apply to the Pflegekasse for a care level.
t.pflege.antrag: A care level has been applied for or might be possible. The Pflegekasse arranges an assessment. From care level 2 there is Pflegegeld if relatives provide the care.
t.pflege.pg1: With care level 1 there is a relief amount of {ent} per month for help in daily life. Pflegegeld starts at care level 2.
t.pflege.pg2: Pflegegeld for care at home: {geld} per month at care level {pg}. In addition there is the relief amount of {ent} per month.
z.ggBezug: You receive Grundsicherungsgeld (until June 2026: Bürgergeld). Wohngeld and Kinderzuschlag usually do not go with it. The education package often runs through the Jobcenter.
z.wgKiz: Wohngeld and Kinderzuschlag can be combined. Apply for both, even if one of them is borderline.
z.gsaWg: You cannot receive Grundsicherung im Alter and Wohngeld at the same time. Have both checked and ask which route is better for you.
z.ggVsWg: Grundsicherungsgeld excludes Wohngeld and Kinderzuschlag. Have both checked and ask which route is better for you.
z.kgZuerst: Apply for Kindergeld first. Without Kindergeld there is no Kinderzuschlag.
z.stichtag: Many benefits are only paid from the month of the application. Apply early, even informally.
z.keine: According to these details no benefit fits for sure. If income, rent or household change, check again. A social counselling service can name further help.
s.kindergeld.wo: At the Familienkasse of the Federal Employment Agency, mostly online.
s.kindergeld.u1: Tax identification numbers of parents and child
s.kindergeld.u3: For children over 18: certificate of training or studies
s.kindergeld.tip: Kindergeld is paid back for six months at most. Apply soon.
s.wohngeld.wo: At the Wohngeldstelle of your municipality, city or district. Applying online is often possible.
s.wohngeld.u1: Rental contract or confirmation of rent
s.wohngeld.u2: Proof of income for all household members, usually for the last 12 months
s.wohngeld.u3: ID documents and details of everyone in the household
s.wohngeld.tip: Wohngeld is paid from the month the application arrives, not backdated. Apply early.
s.kiz.wo: At the Familienkasse, online. There is an official pre-check, the KiZ-Lotse.
s.kiz.u2: Proof of the parents' income, usually for the last 6 months
s.kiz.u3: Details of rent and heating costs
s.kiz.tip: The Kinderzuschlag usually runs for 6 months. After that you need a new application.
s.ggeld.wo: At the Jobcenter of your town or district, in person or online.
s.ggeld.u2: Rental contract and utility bill statement
s.ggeld.u3: Bank statements of the last months and proof of income
s.ggeld.tip: The benefit is paid from the first day of the month in which you apply. Get in touch early.
s.but.wo: At the Kommune (district or city). People who get Grundsicherungsgeld often apply at the Jobcenter at the same time.
s.but.u1: Notice about Wohngeld, Kinderzuschlag or basic security
s.but.u3: Invoice or confirmation, for example for club fees or lunch
s.but.tip: Ask in good time, claims lapse after about twelve months.
s.uvg.wo: At the Unterhaltsvorschussstelle, usually in the Jugendamt of your town or district.
s.uvg.u2: Details of the other parent and proof that he or she pays nothing or too little
s.uvg.tip: The office often claims the money back from the other parent. That is not your problem.
s.gsa.wo: At the Sozialamt of your town or district.
s.gsa.u1: Pension notice or proof of other income
s.gsa.u2: Rental contract and utility bill statement
s.gsa.u3: Bank statements and proof of assets
s.gsa.tip: Children are not asked to pay if their income is below {eur:100000} a year.
s.bafoeg.wo: At the Amt für Ausbildungsförderung, for students at the Studierendenwerk. There is an online application.
s.bafoeg.tip: BAföG is paid from the month of the application. Apply before the training starts.
s.pflege.wo: At the Pflegekasse that belongs to your health insurance. A phone call is enough to apply.
s.pflege.u2: Details of what help is needed in daily life
s.pflege.u3: Medical reports or hospital discharge letters
s.pflege.tip: The Medical Service (Medizinischer Dienst) will visit. Keep a care diary beforehand.
sc.intro: Got an official form? Take a photo of it or paste its text. You will see what each field means and which answer from your check goes there. The app does not fill in the form itself.
sc.paste: Or paste the text of the form
sc.localNote: Default: the photo is read only on your device and sent nowhere. For this, the text recognition downloads a program from the internet once.
sc.claudeNote: Optional: Claude reads the photo more closely. The photo is then sent to Claude and counts toward your Claude usage. Choose only documents you are happy to send.
sc.consent: Yes, the photo may be sent to Claude.
sc.ocrFail: Reading on this device is not available here. Paste the text of the form instead.
sc.claudeFail: Claude could not analyze the form. Try again later or paste the text.
sc.denied: Claude is not allowed or not available here.
sc.rate: Too many requests or your limit is reached. Please try again later.
sc.badImage: This file did not work. Choose a different photo.
sc.need: Choose a photo or paste the text.
sc.noFields: I found no known fields. The photo may be blurry. Otherwise ask an advice center.
sc.res: How to fill in the form
sc.check: Check every entry yourself before you sign. The explanations are a guide, not legal advice.
sc.f.name: Your full name, as on your ID.
sc.f.geb: Your date of birth as day, month and year.
sc.f.adresse: The address where you live and where mail is sent.
sc.f.tel: A phone number for questions. Usually optional.
sc.f.iban: The bank account the money should be paid into. The IBAN is on your bank card.
sc.f.idnr: Numbers such as tax ID or pension insurance number. You find them on letters from the tax office or the pension insurance.
sc.f.haushalt: Everyone who lives with you and shares household costs, with their age and relationship to you.
sc.f.miete: The cost of the home: basic rent, service charges, heating and living space. It is in your rental contract and last statement.
sc.f.einkommen: All money coming into the household: wages, pension, Kindergeld (child benefit), maintenance. Usually gross and net, as on the payslip.
sc.f.vermoegen: Savings, account balances, securities, car, property. List all accounts, even small ones.
sc.f.bezug: Benefits that you or your household already receive or have applied for.
sc.f.unterhalt: Payments from the other parent. Also state it if nothing is paid.
sc.f.ausbildung: School, training or university: institution, start and expected end.
sc.f.gesundheit: Details on disability, care level or reduced earning capacity. Attach the notices as proof.
sc.f.unterschrift: Place, date and your signature. Without a signature the application is often not valid.
brutto2.label: Of this: gross income of the second adult
brutto2.hint: Fill in only if both work. The amount is already included in the gross income above. Empty means only one person works.
cb.nichtArbeit: The income is (almost) not from work, for example pension, unemployment benefit I or sickness benefit.
t.kiz.verm: With substantial assets there is no Kinderzuschlag. Guide value for household size {n}: about {limit}. The Familienkasse decides case by case.
foot.3: This check reflects the 2026 rules. Changes are planned for 2027, for example for Wohngeld (draft law, not yet passed). Amounts may change at the turn of the year.
bh.person.label: Is there a person with a disability?
bh.person.erwVor25: Yes, an adult whose disability began before their 25th birthday
bh.person.erwNach25: Yes, an adult whose disability began only after their 25th birthday
bh.gdb.label: Degree of disability (GdB) of this person
bh.blind.label: Eyesight of the person with a disability
bh.em.label: How many hours a day can an adult currently work?
cb.bhSelbst: Because of the disability, the person cannot support themselves (no or very low income of their own)
cb.em5: Waiting period met: at least 5 years in the pension insurance, including 3 years of compulsory contributions in the last 5 years
cb.wfbm: The person works in a workshop for people with disabilities
cb.babBetrieb: I am doing a vocational training (apprentice) in a recognised training occupation
cb.babWohnt: Because of the training I do not live with my parents, or I am at least 18, married or have a child
n.kgBeh: Child benefit for adult children with a disability
n.eingl: Integration assistance for people with disabilities
n.pausch: Tax allowance for people with disabilities
n.ausweis: Severe disability card and compensation for disadvantages
zu.eingl: Provider of integration assistance (in Bavaria the Bezirk; for children with a mental-health disability the Jugendamt)
zu.pausch: Finanzamt (tax office), in the tax return
zu.arbeit: Provider of integration assistance (in Bavaria usually the Bezirk)
zu.rundfunk: Beitragsservice of ARD, ZDF and Deutschlandradio
u.arzt: Medical reports, expert opinions or severe disability card
u.steuerid: Tax identification number (for Kindergeld also the child’s)
u.rentenverlauf: Insurance number and details of previous employment
u.bescheide: Notices about other benefits, for example Pflegegeld
u.vertrag: Details of the employer and employment contract
u.beitragsnr: Contribution number of the broadcasting fee
u.haushalt: Details of all people in the household
s.kgBeh.wo: At the Familienkasse of the Federal Employment Agency, in writing or online.
s.kgBeh.tip: Kindergeld is paid retroactively for six months at most. Apply early.
s.emrente.wo: At the Deutsche Rentenversicherung, online, in writing or at an advice centre.
s.emrente.tip: The pension insurance first checks whether rehabilitation can restore the ability to work. Get advice before applying.
s.eingl.wo: At the provider of integration assistance. In Bavaria this is usually the Bezirk. For a child with a mental-health disability the Jugendamt is responsible (§ 35a SGB VIII).
s.eingl.tip: Apply early and informally. An independent participation advice service (EUTB) can help with the application.
s.pausch.wo: In the income tax return at the Finanzamt. No separate application is needed.
s.pausch.tip: Anyone who uses the allowance cannot deduct the costs it covers again individually.
s.ausweis.wo: At the Versorgungsamt. In Bavaria this is the Zentrum Bayern Familie und Soziales (ZBFS).
s.ausweis.tip: The card is voluntary but opens access to many compensations for disadvantages.
s.blindengeld.wo: At the Zentrum Bayern Familie und Soziales (ZBFS) or at your municipality.
s.blindengeld.tip: The first application can be informal, oral or by email. Blindengeld is paid from the month of the application at the earliest.
s.pflegeplus.wo: At the Pflegekasse that belongs to your health insurance.
s.pflegeplus.tip: Apply for conversions before the work starts.
s.arbeit.wo: At the provider of integration assistance (in Bavaria usually the Bezirk). Talk to the workshop first.
s.arbeit.tip: The budget is only granted once an employer offers a socially insured employment contract at collective-agreement or locally usual pay.
s.rundfunk.wo: At the Beitragsservice of ARD, ZDF and Deutschlandradio, with the form and the notice of your social benefit.
s.rundfunk.tip: Apply within two months after the notice. The exemption also covers a spouse or registered partner in the same home.
s.zuzahl.tip: Keep all receipts for co-payments. Once the limit is reached, the Krankenkasse issues an exemption for the rest of the year.
s.bab.wo: At the Agentur für Arbeit, online, in writing or in person.
s.bab.tip: Apply before the training starts. If you apply later, payment only starts from the month of application. The BAB calculator of the Federal Employment Agency shows the amount.
s.wbs.wo: At the Wohnungsamt of your municipality or city.
s.wbs.tip: The office calculates the income exactly. Bring proof of income for all household members.
t.kgBeh.keine: For children under 18 the normal Kindergeld applies. This item concerns adults with a disability.
t.kgBeh.nach25: Kindergeld for an adult child with a disability is only paid if the disability began before the 25th birthday. Here it began later.
t.kgBeh.na: You already receive Kindergeld for this child.
t.kgBeh.ja: For an adult child with a disability there can be Kindergeld with no age limit. Condition: the disability began before the 25th birthday and the child cannot support themselves because of it. Kindergeld is {kg} per month. It is the normal Kindergeld, not a second payment on top for the same child.
t.kgBeh.pruefen: Possible if the disability began before the 25th birthday and the child cannot support themselves because of it. The Familienkasse compares the child’s own income with the basic tax allowance ({gfb} in 2026) plus the extra needs caused by the disability. Apply, the Familienkasse will do the calculation.
t.emrente.alter: From the standard retirement age there is no pension for reduced earning capacity any more, but the old-age pension.
t.emrente.keine: A pension for reduced earning capacity is only paid once an adult can work fewer than 6 hours a day because of illness or disability.
t.emrente.voll: Anyone who can work less than 3 hours a day counts as fully incapacitated for earning and gets the full pension.
t.emrente.teil: Anyone who can work 3 to under 6 hours a day counts as partly incapacitated for earning and gets half the pension.
t.emrente.ja: According to your information the waiting period is met. The pension insurance first checks whether rehabilitation can restore the ability to work.
t.emrente.werkstatt: People who work in a workshop for people with disabilities are generally treated as fully incapacitated for earning. Instead of the 5-year waiting period, a waiting period of 20 years can be enough. Have this clarified with the pension insurance.
t.emrente.warte: Usually at least 5 years of insurance and 3 years of compulsory contributions in the last 5 years are needed. There are exceptions, for example after a work accident. Have your insurance periods checked by the pension insurance.
t.eingl.keine: No person with a disability was given.
t.eingl.kind: For children with a disability, for example early intervention, school assistance and help with participation can be considered. For a physical or intellectual disability the provider of integration assistance is responsible, for a mental-health disability the Jugendamt (§ 35a SGB VIII). As to assets, cash assets up to 150 % of the annual reference amount are disregarded (§ 139 SGB IX).
t.eingl.erw: People with a substantial disability can receive integration assistance, for example for assistance in daily life, housing, work or participation in education. As to assets, cash assets up to 150 % of the annual reference amount are disregarded (§ 139 SGB IX). The provider examines each case.
t.pausch.keine: The degree of disability is missing for this.
t.pausch.ja: From GdB 20 there is a disability lump-sum allowance in the tax return. For your degree it is {betrag} per year as a deduction from income. How much tax this saves depends on your tax rate.
t.pausch.kind: For a child you can have the allowance transferred to you on request. It is usually split in half between both parents.
t.ausweis.schwer: From a degree of disability of 50 a person counts as severely disabled. Then there is the severe disability card and compensation for disadvantages, for example {tage} days of paid extra leave per year for a 5-day week.
t.ausweis.gleich: With a GdB of 30 or 40 a person does not count as severely disabled. But they can be treated as equal if, because of the disability, they would otherwise not get or keep a suitable job. You apply at the Agentur für Arbeit.
t.ausweis.niedrig: With a GdB below 30 there is no severe disability card and no equal treatment. The disability lump-sum allowance in tax may still apply.
t.ausweis.antrag: The degree of disability has not been determined yet. At the Versorgungsamt you can apply for the degree of disability and markers. Many further forms of help depend on it.
t.blindengeld.keine: No blindness and no severe visual impairment was given.
t.blindengeld.blind: In Bavaria blind people receive Blindengeld: {betrag} per month (as of {stand}).
t.blindengeld.hoch: In Bavaria severely visually impaired people receive Sehbehindertengeld: {betrag} per month (as of {stand}).
t.blindengeld.pflege: At care level {pg} part of the Pflegegeld is offset (Art. 4 BayBlindG): about {kuerz}. The Blindengeld continues to be paid, but then only about {rest} a month (at least {eur:20}).
t.blindengeld.land: This only applies if you live in Bavaria. Other federal states have their own rules and amounts. Ask the responsible state office there.
t.pflegeplus.antrag: A care level has been applied for or is possible. Once it is determined, further benefits from the Pflegekasse come into question.
t.pflegeplus.keiner: Without a care level these benefits are not available.
t.pflegeplus.mittel: With a care level the Pflegekasse pays, for care at home, disposable care aids up to {verbrauch} per month and a grant for home adaptations (for example an accessible bathroom) up to {wohn} per measure.
t.pflegeplus.verh: From care level 2 there is also respite care and short-term care when the carer is unavailable or needs a break. They share one joint annual amount. Ask the Pflegekasse for the current amount.
t.arbeit.keine: The Budget for work is meant for people who work in a workshop for people with disabilities or would be entitled to a place there.
t.arbeit.ja: People who work in a workshop can move to an employer with the Budget for work. The employer receives a wage subsidy of up to {prozent} % of the wage, plus help at the workplace. A socially insured employment contract at collective-agreement or locally usual pay is required.
kids6.label: of whom under 6 years old (optional, for a more exact standard rate)
kids14.label: of whom 14 to 17 years old (optional)
t.fehlt.einkommen: Enter the household’s monthly gross income (0 if there is none). Only then can this benefit be assessed.
t.fehlt.vermoegen: Enter your assets (savings), 0 if you have none.
t.fehlt.miete: Enter your rent, 0 if you pay none.
first.text: The Leistungs-Lotse gives guidance. It is not legal advice and does not replace an official decision. The responsible office always decides on your entitlement.
t.rundfunk.mehr: Other grounds for exemption include BAföG, Berufsausbildungsbeihilfe or Ausbildungsgeld (if you do not live with your parents), benefits under the Asylbewerberleistungsgesetz, Hilfe zur Pflege, Blindenhilfe and deaf-blindness. If you are refused an exemption, you can apply for a hardship exemption; this usually requires a rejection notice first. People with certain disability marks can get a reduction to one third.
t.wbs.abzug: The calculation is simplified. Depending on the case, flat-rate deductions are taken from income (up to 30 %, but each only if you actually pay taxes, health/care insurance or retirement provision), plus allowances, for example {eur:4000} for each severely disabled household member, and a maintenance deduction. The housing authority of your city or municipality makes the exact check.
t.rundfunk.bezug: Anyone who receives Grundsicherung, social assistance or Grundsicherungsgeld can be exempted from the broadcasting fee. This also applies to a spouse or registered partner in the same home.
t.rundfunk.folgt: If you are granted Grundsicherung or Grundsicherungsgeld, you can then be exempted from the broadcasting fee. The same can apply to other social benefits, for example blind assistance.
t.rundfunk.haerte: If your income exceeds the needs threshold of a social benefit by less than the broadcasting fee, you can apply as a special hardship case.
t.rundfunk.nein: According to your information there is no entitlement to exemption. It is mainly granted when receiving certain social benefits.
t.zuzahl.keine: No disability or need for care was given.
t.zuzahl.grenze: For co-payments on medicines, aids and treatments there is a limit of 2 % of the annual gross income for living expenses. Once it is reached, the Krankenkasse issues an exemption for the rest of the year. There are allowances for family members in the household.
t.zuzahl.chron: For people with a serious chronic illness the limit is 1 %. This includes, for example, someone with a GdB of at least 60 who is in continuous treatment. The Krankenkasse decides.
t.bab.keine: Vocational training allowance is for apprentices in a recognised training occupation. A matching entry is missing.
t.bab.wohnen: Vocational training allowance is available if you cannot live with your parents because of the training. From age 18, if married or with a child of your own, this condition is not needed.
t.bab.ja: Possible. The amount depends on your income and the income of your parents or partner. Their income only counts above allowances. The BAB calculator of the Federal Employment Agency shows you the amount. As a rule it must be your first training.
t.wbs.ja: Your gross income is below the limit for subsidised housing in Bavaria: {grenze} per year for your household. The Wohnungsamt calculates exactly (with deductions) and checks further conditions.
t.wbs.rand: Your gross income is above the limit of {grenze} per year, but after deductions for taxes and insurance it may be below. The Wohnungsamt calculates exactly.
t.wbs.hoch: Even with the possible deductions, the income is probably above the limit of {grenze} per year for subsidised housing in Bavaria.
t.ggeld.ausbildung: People in school, studies or training that can be funded through BAföG usually do not get Grundsicherungsgeld, even if no BAföG is actually paid. Exceptions apply only in certain cases, for example evening school or where no BAföG is possible for the school. Certain extra needs, for example in pregnancy or for single parents, are possible. The Jobcenter decides whether an exception applies to you.
t.wohngeld.ausbildung: If everyone in the household is in principle entitled to BAföG or Berufsausbildungsbeihilfe, there is no Wohngeld (§ 20 WoGG). This also applies if the benefit is not paid because of your income or assets. There are exceptions, for example if the training is not eligible for funding. Have this checked at the Wohngeldstelle.
t.wohngeld.keineMiete: You did not enter any rent. Wohngeld is a subsidy towards rent. People living in their own house or flat can get a Lastenzuschuss. Enter your housing costs or ask at the Wohngeldstelle.
t.wohngeld.zuNiedrigVerm: Wohngeld requires a minimum income. Your income probably does not cover living costs and rent. Because of your assets, Grundsicherung is unlikely to be an option. Ask at the Wohngeldstelle whether an application makes sense.
beh.hint: Only open this if it applies: people with a disability, reduced earning capacity or in training.

t.wbs.gebiet: Your income is above the general limit of {grenze} per year. In areas with high housing demand the municipality can set higher limits of up to {max}. Ask the Wohnungsamt whether this applies to you.

t.land.blindengeld: This blind person's allowance under the Bavarian Blindengeldgesetz exists only in Bavaria. Your federal state has its own state allowance with different rules and amounts. Ask the responsible state office or Versorgungsamt.
t.land.wbs: The app's income limits for the Wohnberechtigungsschein (housing entitlement certificate) apply only in Bavaria. Your federal state has its own limits. Ask the housing authority of your city or municipality.

plz.hint: The app uses it to find your federal state and rent level. What you enter stays on your device.
plz.notFound: I don't know this postcode. Check your entry, or choose the federal state and rent level yourself.

plz.unknown: No rent level is stored for this place. Choose it yourself below.

bl.hint: Important for Blindengeld and the Wohnberechtigungsschein. So far the app only calculates these for Bavaria.

beh.stelle: Responsible office for where you live:
beh.pruefen: Address from official information (the authority's legal notice or BayernPortal, retrieved {stand}). Please check before sending; offices sometimes move.
beh.ohneAdr: You can find the address on the authority's website.
beh.plzHint: Enter your postcode above and the app will show the responsible office with its address (currently for Bavaria).
beh.fkUnklar: For where you live, the official directory lists Familienkasse Bayern Nord (post: {nord}) or Bayern Süd (post: {sued}). The free Familienkasse service number tells you which one is responsible: {tel}.
f.adrFehlt: To fill in the address of the responsible office, the app needs your postcode (currently for Bavaria). Enter it in the questionnaire above or in your address under "postcode and town", and the app will add the recipients.
unterh.label: Maintenance for the children per month
unterh.hint: What the other parent pays for the children, for all children together. Leave empty if nothing is paid. Do not enter Unterhaltsvorschuss here. Include maintenance for yourself in your income.
t.uvg.teil: The maintenance the children already receive ({u} per month) is deducted. Unterhaltsvorschuss is only paid for the part by which it falls short of the Unterhaltsvorschuss amount.
t.uvg.genug: The children already receive {u} maintenance per month. That is at least as much as Unterhaltsvorschuss; the maintenance paid is fully deducted.
